caption: The drawing depicts a wooden frame structure, positioned with four legs pointing upward. The frame consists of four wooden posts at the corners, each topped with a rounded wooden knob. The posts are joined by horizontal wooden beams that form a rectangular boundary. Between these beams, several ropes are threaded horizontally and vertically, crossing each other to form a grid or lattice pattern within the frame's borders. The ropes appear to be a light beige or off-white color, contrasting with the medium brown tone of the wooden posts and beams. The wooden elements are illustrated with visible grain patterns and rounded decorative features at the top and bottom of each post. Two loose rope ends hang from the right side of the frame, with their fibers visibly frayed. The background is plain, allowing clear visibility of the structure and its components.
title: Doll's Bed
